checks.what: Four independent audits read all 1,280 cards: glossary cards against the ISTQB Glossary they quote, word for word as found by the card checker, and syllabus cards (written in our own words, as the syllabus is all rights reserved) against the CTFL v4.0.1 syllabus, with every test-technique scenario worked out
checks.result: 3 wrong cards were fixed (among them 'completion criteria', which v4.0.1 treats as another name for exit criteria); about 110 syllabus cards worded too close to the syllabus, or reusing its examples, were rewritten in our own words; 79 unsupported claims, 1 ambiguous card and 10 unclear ones were also fixed.
